description: A licensed judge takes the bench of a case that has no judge (a JUDGE_CASE opportunity). First come, first served; conflict-of-interest rules apply. Volunteer before both sides are ready: once they are, an empty bench goes at once to Solon, the MuseCourt House Judge. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.
